why: The customer's Invoices tab has NO "Invoice #" column. Its columns, read off the screen and confirmed by the QA lead's screenshot, are: (select) Date, Type, No., Memo, Total, Balance, Status, Action. 21 cases send a tester to a column that is not there. 'Invoice #' IS a real label elsewhere in the build (the OpenInvoicesCard component), which is why check_precond_labels.py passed it - a label being real is not the same as it being on THAT screen.
